item.title: State of Texas: Texas teachers may lose jobs for posts on Kirk's death
item.description: Some Texas educators risk losing their ability to teach over comments they made on social media in the wake of the shooting death of Turning Point USA founder Charlie Kirk.

item.title: New exhibit honors USS Indianapolis crew, Panhandle survivor Cleatus Lebow
item.description: A new permanent exhibit honoring the crew of the USS Indianapolis, including Texas Panhandle survivor Cleatus Lebow, is now open at the Texas Panhandle War Memorial Center.

item.title: 2 ENMU alumni apart of Seattle Seahawks coaching staff for the Big Game
item.description: Eastern New Mexico University announced that it has two connections in the Big Game with Jeff Howard as Seattle Seahawks Safeties Coach and Seattle Seahawks Strength and Conditioning Coach Tim Ojeda.

item.title: What the future holds for the Panhandle-Plains Historical Museum
item.description: The Panhandle-Plains Historical Museum has remained closed since the a fire marshal report cited safety violations. WT President Walter Wendler decided to close the museum in March, citing danger to the public.
